subject.title: fix(browser): prove post-action target continuity before adopting a tab

question: Should this PR be expanded to make browser-operation target identity backend-owned across the managed Playwright, extension-relay, and Chrome MCP paths before any replacement is reported?
rationale: The reported target is a correctness boundary for later mutating browser actions, and choosing between a bounded backend-outcome refactor and retaining heuristic replacement behavior affects the long-term browser contract.

options.title: Return backend-owned outcomes
options.body: Require each backend operation to return its exact selected target or an explicit stale/closed result, then remove resolver-based target adoption.

options.title: Keep heuristic replacement
options.body: Accept that newly appeared or URL-matched tabs may be treated as continuity, with the remaining wrong-target edge cases as an intentional risk.

options.title: Pause for a narrower contract
options.body: Hold the PR while browser owners define the minimum shared target-identity contract and regression matrix.

recommendation.title: Return backend-owned outcomes
recommendation.body: Require each backend operation to return its exact selected target or an explicit stale/closed result, then remove resolver-based target adoption.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged renderer-swap implementation is the closest concrete history for the target-resolution contract affected here.
